author: Nia Warfield
title: Your first trade for Wednesday, July 11
text:
The " Fast Money " traders shared their first moves for the market open.
Pete Najarian was a buyer of Constellation Brands .
Brian Kelly was a buyer of Consumer Staples .
Dan Nathan was a seller of the Russell 2000 ETF .
Tim Seymour was a buyer of Amgen .
